description: SWMM Hydrology Datasets of ITB Jatinangor Campus is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Faizal Rohmat, Putu Amarta Sadwika Sukma (Bandung Institute of Technology). Dataset for hydrologic modelling using SWMM Historical SWMM Model and ResultsThis simulation uses 10 years of historical data from GSMaP. This dataset includes rainfall data (.DAT), SWMM model (.inp and .ini), simulation result (.xlsx), and map background (.jpg) Future Extreme SWMM ModelThis folder contains 3 models representing undeveloped, developed, and GR-modified scenarios. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support water-network, drainage and hydraulic studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
